one_line: A master artisan of early Gandhara who fused Hellenistic drapery with Indian Buddhist imagery in stone.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, lean but strong artisan build with slightly calloused hands and defined forearms.
appearance.face: Oval face with gently angular jaw, wheat-brown complexion, straight nose, wide attentive dark eyes, finely arched brows, and a few faint chisel-nicks and stone-dust freckles on the cheeks; default expression is focused, calm curiosity as if studying a block of stone.
appearance.hair: Dark brown-black hair in soft waves, medium length to just above the shoulders, parted slightly off-center and tied back into a low, narrow knot at the nape with a thin dull-red cloth band; a simple narrow tan headband of twisted cloth sits across the forehead to keep stray strands back, with a few wisps falling around the temples.
appearance.costume: A knee-length, light-cream cotton tunic with simple round neck and narrow long sleeves, slightly stained with stone dust, is worn under a wrapped outer garment that hints at Greco-Roman and local styles: a muted slate-blue woolen himation-style drape starting over the left shoulder, crossing the torso and wrapping around the waist, leaving the right arm more free and forming soft, heavy folds reminiscent of Hellenistic sculpture; around the waist is a practical dark-brown leather belt with small loops for tools, over which a narrow ochre cloth sash is tied once on the left hip; loose, ankle-length off-white cotton trousers are gathered with simple cords above the ankles; feet wear sturdy brown leather sandals with toe and ankle straps suited to workshop floors; minimal jewellery: a single small bronze stud earring in the left ear and a plain bronze bangle on the right wrist, suggesting modest artisan status within a cosmopolitan city.
appearance.signature: A smooth, pale-grey stone Buddha head in early Gandharan style held in the left arm—complete with ushnisha, subtle urna and softly Hellenistic facial features—while the right hand grips a short wooden mallet and iron chisel crossed in front, both worn and polished from constant use.

ref_desc: A lean wheat-brown Gandhara sculptor with shoulder-length dark hair tied in a low knot and a tan headband, wearing a cream tunic, slate-blue himation-style drape, ochre sash, brown sandals, and carrying a pale-grey stone Buddha head plus mallet and chisel.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of a Gandhara sculptor from c. 1st century BCE–2nd century CE: a lean wheat-brown artisan with an oval face, wide dark eyes, and shoulder-length dark hair tied into a low knot at the nape, held back with a narrow tan cloth headband and a few loose wisps at the temples. Show him in a modest, historically grounded workshop outfit: a long-sleeved, light-cream cotton tunic reaching the knees, slightly dusted from stone, worn under a wrapped outer garment resembling a Greco-Roman himation fused with local style—a slate-blue wool drape starting over the left shoulder, crossing the torso, wrapping the waist and falling in heavy, sculptural folds while freeing the right arm. At his waist, depict a practical dark-brown leather belt with small tool loops, over which a narrow muted-ochre cloth sash is tied at the left hip, and loose off-white cotton trousers gathered just above the ankles into simple cords. Put plain brown leather sandals on his feet and add minimal adornment: a single small bronze stud earring in the left ear and a plain bronze bangle on the right wrist. His signature prop should be a smooth pale-grey stone Buddha head in early Gandharan style cradled in his left arm, clearly showing an ushnisha, subtle urna and soft Hellenistic facial features, while his right hand crosses in front gripping a short wooden mallet and an iron chisel, both worn from use. Emphasize the slate-blue, light-cream, muted-ochre, brown leather and pale-grey stone palette, and present him from multiple angles in the same outfit and hairstyle, capturing his calm, focused expression and the blend of Indian Buddhist and Hellenistic influences in his tools and carved head.
